content: openai Python SDK: latest version 2.54.0 (August 2026), requires Python >=3.10. Structured outputs via client.responses.parse(text_format=MyModel) with Pydantic BaseModel. REST API uses text.format.type='json_schema' with strict=true. parse() method returns response.output_parsed as the typed object. OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, LM Studio, LocalAI, Ollama) work by setting base_url= on the OpenAI() client constructor, api_key can be any string. NOTE: openai SDK 2.x requires Python >=3.10, incompatible with Python 3.9. The 1.x series (e.g. 1.85.0) requires Python >=3.7.1 and may be used for 3.9 support.
